meta.title: Score a vendor's technical answers during evaluation

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event's Responses screen as required for evaluation cases.
Navigate from the pricing responses to the Technical Stage.

args.goal: as the evaluator, open Vendor A's technical response, give a score to every question, submit the scores, and stop when the screen shows the evaluation saved or submitted against Vendor A

steps.note: Perform the evaluator-only scoring and submission flow, including verifying that the submitted scores are shown for Vendor A.
Confirm the resulting evaluation screen has no rendering errors or server failures.
